resolution_notes: Auditor correct on example.request only: official Mastodon client auth docs describe OAuth 2.0 access tokens (Authorization: Bearer), not API keys — see https://docs.joinmastodon.org/client/token/ and https://docs.joinmastodon.org/api/oauth-scopes/. Original example used YOUR_API_KEY; corrected label is YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN. No other fields disputed; status remains operational.
